cookbook.diag_msg_kv_cache_oom: No GPU memory left for KV cache after loading model.
cookbook.diag_msg_warmup_oom: OOM during warmup. Lower GPU memory or max sequences.
cookbook.diag_msg_gpu_oom: GPU ran out of memory. Try more GPUs (higher TP) or lower context.
cookbook.diag_msg_fp8_moe_tp: FP8 MoE quantization is incompatible with this tensor-parallel split.
cookbook.diag_msg_modelopt_lmhead: vLLM cannot load this ModelOpt LM-head quantized checkpoint with the current runtime.
cookbook.diag_msg_tp_dimensions: Tensor parallel size incompatible with model dimensions.
cookbook.diag_msg_swap_too_large: Swap space too large for available CPU memory.
cookbook.diag_msg_no_cpu_ram: Not enough CPU RAM or swap space.
cookbook.diag_msg_swap_removed: --swap-space was removed in newer vLLM versions. Remove it from the command.
cookbook.diag_msg_port_in_use: Port is already in use. Another server may be running.
cookbook.diag_msg_no_gpus_visible: No GPUs visible. Check your GPU selection or driver.
cookbook.diag_msg_gated_model: Gated model. Your HF token IS being sent — but its account must be granted access first: open the model page, accept the license, and wait for approval (Meta models can take a while).
cookbook.diag_msg_single_file_base: Single-file checkpoint needs a base model for missing components (text encoder, VAE). The base model may be gated — accept the license and set your HF token.
cookbook.diag_msg_single_file_config: Single-file model — needs base config from a gated repo. Accept the license and set your HF token.
cookbook.diag_msg_model_not_found: Model path or ID not found.
cookbook.diag_msg_context_too_large: Context length too large for available GPU memory.
cookbook.diag_msg_vllm_missing: vLLM is not installed or not in PATH.
cookbook.diag_msg_sglang_deps_missing: SGLang native dependencies are missing on this server.
cookbook.diag_msg_sglang_missing: SGLang is not installed or not in PATH.
cookbook.diag_msg_sglang_no_gpu: SGLang needs a visible GPU/accelerator on this server.
cookbook.diag_msg_vllm_no_cuda: vLLM needs a visible CUDA/ROCm GPU.
cookbook.diag_msg_vllm_engine_failed: vLLM engine failed to start. Check the error above.
cookbook.diag_msg_model_format: Model format incompatible with this vLLM version.
cookbook.diag_msg_auto_tool_choice: Auto tool choice needs a tool call parser.
cookbook.diag_msg_arch_too_new: Model architecture too new for installed vLLM/transformers.
cookbook.diag_msg_ollama_missing: Ollama is not installed on this server. Run: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
cookbook.diag_msg_cmake_required: cmake is required to compile llama.cpp from source, but it is not installed on this server.
cookbook.diag_msg_cc_compiler_required: A C/C++ compiler (build-essential / base-devel) is required to compile llama.cpp.
cookbook.diag_msg_git_required: git is required to clone the llama.cpp source tree.
cookbook.diag_msg_llama_cpp_server_missing: llama-cpp-python server is not installed. Run: pip install "llama-cpp-python[server]"
cookbook.diag_msg_avx2_mismatch: AVX2 Instruction Set Mismatch: the precompiled llama-cpp-python wheel requires CPU features (AVX2/FMA) that your processor or virtual machine lacks.
cookbook.diag_msg_cuda_runtime_missing: llama.cpp found nvcc, but the CUDA runtime library is missing.
cookbook.diag_msg_diffusion_deps: Diffusion serving needs PyTorch and diffusers. Install diffusers from Cookbook → Dependencies.
cookbook.diag_msg_triton_mismatch: Triton kernels version mismatch. Non-fatal warning — model will still run, just without optimized MoE kernels.
cookbook.diag_msg_disk_full: Disk full on the server. Free up space before retrying.
cookbook.diag_msg_network_failed: Network connection failed. Server may be unreachable or HuggingFace is down.
cookbook.diag_msg_attention_unsupported: Model uses attention features unsupported in this vLLM version.
cookbook.diag_msg_flashinfer_nvcc_old: FlashInfer is JIT-compiling sampling kernels with an nvcc too old for this GPU (no sm_89 / sm_90 support — pre-CUDA 11.8). Changing the attention backend does not help — flashinfer JITs the SAMPLER too. The clean fix is to set VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 so vLLM uses its native sampler instead.
cookbook.diag_msg_torch_abi: vLLM was built against a newer torch than what is installed. Reinstall vLLM so pip pulls a compatible torch (or upgrade torch directly).
cookbook.diag_msg_dep_build_failed: A dependency failed to build during install — usually an older package whose build breaks on this Python version, not a server problem. The install did not finish.
cookbook.diag_msg_vllm_wedged: A vLLM process hit a Python traceback and may be wedged.
cookbook.diag_msg_traceback_detected: Python traceback detected — check the captured output below for the underlying error.
cookbook.diag_msg_awq_unified_memory: AWQ/GPTQ/FP8 cannot be served through llama.cpp/Ollama unified-memory mode.
cookbook.diag_msg_awq_needs_accel: AWQ/GPTQ/FP8 needs a working vLLM/SGLang accelerator path; this server did not expose one.
cookbook.diag_msg_pip_no_marker: Pip install did not finish with a success marker. Check the output for the underlying error.
cookbook.diag_sug_lower_tp: Suggested action: retry with a lower tensor-parallel size, such as TP=4 or TP=2. If it still fails, use a non-FP8/GGUF version of the model.
cookbook.diag_sug_upgrade_env: Suggested action: upgrade vLLM through the environment that provides this CLI (package manager, venv, Docker image, or source checkout), or choose a compatible checkpoint.
cookbook.diag_sug_switch_llamacpp: Suggested action: switch this serve config to llama.cpp for CPU/local serving, or choose a GPU server.
cookbook.diag_sug_install_cmake: Suggested action: install cmake via the OS package manager — apt: cmake build-essential / pacman: cmake base-devel / dnf: cmake gcc-c++ make / brew: cmake. Cookbook can do this automatically on the next launch if your user has passwordless sudo for apt/pacman/dnf.
cookbook.diag_sug_switch_ollama: Suggested action: switch this serve config to Ollama (highly recommended, has dynamic CPU fallbacks), or choose a remote Linux GPU server.
cookbook.diag_sug_relaunch_runner: Suggested action: relaunch with the updated runner so llama.cpp builds CPU-only, or install a complete CUDA toolkit/runtime on this server for GPU llama.cpp.
cookbook.diag_sug_flashinfer_sampler: Suggested action: relaunch with VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 prepended. (Confirmed on the QuantTrio/Qwen3.5 model card as the canonical workaround.)
cookbook.diag_sug_check_build_output: Suggested action: check the captured output for the package that failed to build; it may need a newer release or a patch to install on this Python version.
cookbook.diag_sug_read_failed_step: Suggested action: read the captured output for the failing step; copy the troubleshooting bundle if you need help.
cookbook.diag_sug_awq_accel_sug: Suggested action: use vLLM/SGLang on a compatible CUDA/ROCm GPU server, or download a GGUF version for llama.cpp/Ollama/unified-memory serving.
cookbook.diag_sug_choose_cuda_server: Suggested action: choose a CUDA/ROCm server where vLLM/SGLang can see the GPU, or download a GGUF version and serve it with llama.cpp/Ollama.
cookbook.diag_sug_copy_bundle: Suggested action: copy the troubleshooting bundle. Common causes: missing build deps, network blip, mismatched torch ABI.
cookbook.diag_sug_default_copy_error: Suggested action: copy the error and adjust the serve settings.
